verdict.rationale: Paperspace's own marketing documents an "ML in a Box" machine template that comes preinstalled with the major ML frameworks and CUDA drivers. Its machine-creation docs also let developers pick an OS or a saved template instead of building from scratch, which covers the PyTorch/CUDA core of the story. But the evidence is a single marketing line plus generic template docs, with no catalog of distinct pre-built stacks. missing for 10: vLLM template, ComfyUI template, a documented catalog of named framework templates (e.g. specific PyTorch/CUDA versions), in-depth template docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
